lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn₂Si₄Se₄ (Zn(SiSe)₂) adopts the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Si centers coordinated by four Se neighbors and tetrahedral Zn centers coordinated by four Se neighbors; each Se center has two Si and two Zn geometric neighbors. The Si and Zn tetrahedra are observed to share corners, as are the Si–Si and Zn–Zn tetrahedral pairs, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
